trial_court: Family Court-cum-V Additional District Judge, Tirupati (F.C.O.P.No.110/2018)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Appellant/petitioner (father) seeking guardianship and custody of minor boy N.Jainarayan Sai

facts_of_case: Petitioner is the father of minor boy N.Jainarayan Sai born to him and respondent in Michigan, U.S.A. They got divorced in Michigan, U.S.A. Petitioner seeks guardianship and custody of the minor boy. Trial court dismissed his petition.

legal_principles.principle: The jurisdiction of a court should be decided based on the merits of the case and not by declining jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above judgments, the lower Court ought to have decided the matter on merits instead of declining the jurisdiction.
applicable_acts_sections: Uniform Child-Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act (UCCJEA) — Section 202(1)(b)
cited_cases: Yashita Sahu v. State of Rajasthan, (Year) X SCC Y
Nithya Anand Raghavan v. State of NCT of Delhi, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A court's jurisdiction is determined by the ordinary place of residence of a minor child.
legal_principles.held: said place has become the ordinary place of residence of the minor boy and therefore, the Family Court at Tirupati holds jurisdiction to try the guardian petition.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the order passed by the trial court is set aside.

use_for_drafting: advising on joint legal and physical custody
